name: Book 2 Part A Exercise Authoring Contract
scope: Define the canonical seven-section Part A textbook exercise sequence for Book 2 and later books.
Use the seven canonical exercise headings in exact order and at exact Markdown level ## across every active surface that restates them.
Retain a compact non-heading summary after the worked example and before Startopgaven for Book 1 continuity; never turn it into an eighth exercise heading.
Make the printed Part A route complete on paper for a no-device classroom and remove student-facing website, device, Part A, Part B, lane, and companion-route terminology.
Align active didactic, authoring, workflow, PDF, and review guidance without creating competing sources of truth.

Align visual fading across the exercise builder, didactic reference, question-design reference, didactic skill, and paragraph checklist so target-supplied representations remain and graph/table production is never added unless it is a target operation.
Enforce the printed no-device boundary for Dutch and English student copy, including telefoon, smartphone, computer, internet, app, QR-code, digitale uitleg, digitaal hulpmiddel, and scan de code.
Require backward design from lesson goals through target-operation decomposition to worked example and practice.
Require the short route Startopgaven to Zelfstandige oefening to Doeloefening, optional scaffolded support, cognitive-flexibility bonus, and closing accessible cumulative review.

Add a focused, non-retroactive active-guidance contract checker with heading-level, summary-placement, paper-route, Dutch/English digital-dependency, all-five-surface target-aligned-fading, and structural mutation tests plus platform-CI wiring.
Use role-specific checker obligations so didactic rationale and the full operational builder remain distinct while other surfaces inherit concisely.
Keep Book 1, 4veco-lessen, Book 2 lesson production, Part B redesign, protected references, source data, and target registries unchanged.
acceptance_tests: npm.cmd run check:paragraph-lane-scope -- --lane shared --base origin/main --head HEAD
forbidden: No edits to 4veco-lessen or Book 1 lesson/output files.
No Book 2 paragraph source or generated lesson output.
No edits under references/machine or references/external.
No source-data, target-exercise registry, candidate-storage, or PV writes.
No Part B companion route redesign or implementation.
No retroactive validation of Book 1 and no schema enum migration.
No student-facing printed template may advertise or depend on a website, device, online explanation, Part B, lane, or companion route.
No active inherited instruction may unconditionally remove a target-supplied visual or add graph/table production absent from the approved target operation and answer form.
No merge or Book 2 production authority; task closure may reach READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW only.
Final closure requires PR #219 to be cleanly mergeable, non-draft, exact-head green, and synchronized with result and PR-description evidence.
